note: Citing works found by OpenCitations that Semantic Scholar never returned, mostly because its citations endpoint caps at 1000 results and the PLDI 2013 anchor exceeds it. Kept as a separate pool because they carry no S2 id. Note that 22 of these turned out to be ACM SIGPLAN Notices twins of works already in lane_a, so the net gain is about 201, not 223. Two further OpenCitations rows were unusable: they cram several DOIs, space separated, into a single field.

regenerate: This file is a checkpoint of the 221 DOIs OpenCitations returned that Semantic Scholar did not, with only enough metadata to identify them; affiliations.py needs the doi field alone. The full list is rebuilt by unioning opencitations.net/index/api/v1/citations/<doi> across every DOI alias in data/anchors.json and subtracting the S2 pool. Only the six most-cited entries are inlined here; rerun the union to restore the rest.
